title: Terms of Payment Arrangements — Where the Plan's Term Is Counted From
content:
The term window start of a re-aged plan under Payment Arrangements follows how the plan began.

## Terms

1. A plan that took a down payment counts its term from the scheduled due date of installment 1 as carried on its payment entries, and when installment 1 carries no payment entry it is treated as a plan without a down payment.
2. A plan without a down payment that was authorized more than 3 days after its creation date counts its term from its authorization date.
3. Any other plan counts its term from its creation date.

The down payment, the creation date and the authorization date are read from the plan record; the scheduled due date of installment 1 from the installment payment entries booked to installment 1 on the plan's installment history. The 3 days are calendar days from the creation date to the authorization date.

## Condition table

| Down payment on the plan | Installment 1 has a payment entry | Authorized more than 3 days after creation | Term counted from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Any | The scheduled due date of installment 1 |
| Yes | No | Yes | The authorization date |
| Yes | No | No | The creation date |
| No | — | Yes | The authorization date |
| No | — | No | The creation date |

## Hypothetical plans

- Created 2 May with a down payment; installment 1, scheduled for 1 June, carries a payment entry: the term counts from 1 June.
- Created 2 May without a down payment, authorized 6 May (4 days later): the term counts from 6 May.
- Created 2 May without a down payment, authorized 5 May (3 days later, not more than 3): the term counts from 2 May.
- Created 2 May with a down payment, installment 1 never paid, authorized 3 May: treated as without a down payment and authorized within 3 days — the term counts from 2 May.
